summary: This paper presents TRIFF-CERT-1.0, an exhaustive machine-checked Lean 4.35.0 and zero-float Python verification suite auditing Bhandari and Khetan's improved trifferent code bounds T(n) = Omega(1.162579^n). The work combines 18 constructive Lean theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) and 16 canonical exact-rational JSON certificates verified via AST-audited Python code over Z and Q.
weaknesses: Excludes local replay of the 11,713-leaf external triple subdivision file of Appendix A.3, relying instead on underlying local rule and bound audits.
